statement: Everyone would be happier with a purpose; if you have none, your purpose is to find one. By 2024 he says the ultimate purpose of life is love. If you can't say what you're doing with your life, you're going through the motions.

title: Nihilism is self-destructive
statement: Nihilism and the black pill are self-destructive: digest the bleak truth and turn it into a weapon. His ranking: active pessimist best, then active optimist, passive optimist, and passive pessimist worst.
status: changed — 2020: nihilism read positively ("true nihilism" gives meaning back); 2021-22: "the most abject limitation", and believing nothing is worse than believing something wrong.

title: Suffering is not evil
statement: "A true man says life is suffering with a smile." Amor fati means accepting hardship without becoming cruel.

title: Escape through books, not screens
statement: Escapism into artificial paradises verges on nihilism; if you must escape, books are healthiest because they take effort and have no algorithm. Transhumanism is escapism: optimise the biology you have first.

title: Decision and time tools
statement: Coin-flip trick (the side you hope for is your decision); spend little time on big one-off decisions and more on small recurring ones; cut sunk costs early; never apply a permanent solution to a temporary problem. Write your schedule down and cut what's unnecessary; waking early doesn't make you productive.
numbers: Don't let your 17- or 20-year-old self bind your 40-year-old self.

title: Own tools, not possessions
statement: Possessions end up possessing you. People in their 20s should buy as little as possible; consumption is about forgetting yourself. Sports cars and watches are the "worst self-improvement advice".
numbers: Test: 1 month without buying non-perishable goods.

title: Money is a tool
statement: Money is a tool and necessary evil; earn enough for bills, savings and family, since chasing more fills a spiritual void. Capitalism is fine, but selling principles for wealth means money owns you.
numbers: Rent went from ~300 to ~2,000 a month since his childhood.
status: contradicted — he is detached from money and hasn't looked at a paycheck in years (2021), cares little (2024), yet says money "matters enormously" given living costs (2024).

title: A job is for making a living
statement: Take a tolerable job that leaves time for hobbies and family; don't monetise your passion or chase a dream job. If your job feels pointless, find meaning outside it. Drifting into a passionless job that swallows your identity is alienation.
status: changed — 2020-21: "work is happiness", fulfilling work stops feeling like work, "rat race" talk is cope; 2022-24: a job is an obligation, don't seek fulfilment in it, hustle culture alienates men.

title: Career tactics
statement: Pursue degrees only with clear job prospects; study what you love because you'll compete with people who do; no loyalty to companies (get raises with competing offers); apply everywhere and ignore listed requirements; admit you can't do a task rather than fail it.
numbers: In 2018: 100 applications → ~8 callbacks → 1 job; in big companies ~20% of staff do 95% of the work (his claim).

title: His stance on monetising his work
statement: He refuses ads and sponsorships and has "a moral problem" charging for help; from 2025 he offers paid lessons that reward consistency. Supporters living paycheck to paycheck shouldn't donate.
numbers: Seeker tier 4 h/month, max 10 students; long-term students pay ~30% less.
status: changed — 2022 he preferred clocking out at 5 PM as an employee; 2023 he'd rather work for his audience; 2025 paid lessons.

title: Love is always worth it
statement: Love is the ultimate purpose and always worth it, even at the cost of betrayal. It is irrational, a responsibility you impose on yourself; love is equal exchange while adoration is one-sided.

title: Lust is a firework, love a fire
statement: Lust is the necessary first step and love is what remains when novelty fades; losing feelings right after sex means it was lust. What men call lust is often a need for touch.

title: Build yourself before a relationship
statement: A girlfriend won't cure loneliness: "to find the one, be the one". A couple must stay two individuals or becomes codependent. You are the most important person in your life until you have kids.

title: Marriage is for life
statement: Marriage is sacred and for life; he is a "fierce defender" of it. A soulmate is made through commitment, not found. Young men's fear of love is really fear of vulnerability.
numbers: Tens of thousands to millions of possible matches.

title: Relationship timeline
statement: Learn to talk to girls as a teen, date lightly young, don't rush marriage, and never marry someone you haven't lived with. Being single in your late 20s or 30s is not late.
numbers: Most dating potential 14 to 20-23; light dating 16-17; don't marry at 18; 25 is not old; 33 unmarried is the start; men peak in their 40s-50s; date 1.5-2 years → live together 1-2 years → marry; ~30 ideal for kids.

title: Sex belongs in commitment
statement: Delay sex to build connection; serial casual sex and hookup culture damage both sexes. Sex 50 times with one partner builds something, with 50 people nothing.
numbers: First-date-sex relationships last "about two weeks".
status: changed — 2020-21: serial casual dating is immoral; 2024: still against hookup culture, but a woman's casual past doesn't damage her and short relationships teach something. Also contradicted by his own account of sleeping with many women in long-distance relationships.

title: Meeting women: initiate and learn by doing
statement: You learn by approaching and taking rejection, not from YouTube theory. Build a connection first, practise with low stakes and escalate before the friend-zone window closes. Meet women through friends, shared hobbies, classes and female-dominated activities; avoid dating apps and workplace dating.
numbers: He was rejected 25-26+ times; ~3-4 approaches/month in college; cold approach works ~1 in 100; selectivity ~20% in real life vs ~95% on apps (his figures).

title: Dates
statement: The best first date is a walk in a nice, populated area: low-stakes, free, easy to leave. He never pays on a first date; if a date is cancelled the next step is hers; end with a gesture that sets up the next date. Consent: move slowly, accept "no" and continue only on clear signals.

title: What attracts women, in his view
statement: Confidence, competence, strength, humour and charisma (eye contact, posture, hygiene) attract; neediness, desperation and weakness repel. Looks matter a lot, with personality on top. He rejects pickup "game" and negging.

title: Keeping a relationship alive
statement: Keep dating your wife and don't turn submissive out of fear of losing her; hold firm under tests without anger or ultimatums; listen rather than solve; carry no resentment; it's the two of you against the problem. Political differences don't matter if fundamentals match.

title: When to leave
statement: Cheating, including emotional cheating, is a hard boundary. Leave a partner who insults or screams at you or threatens suicide to keep you; "a break" means it's over; never have kids with a drug user; fear of being alone is no reason to stay.
numbers: Picture yourself 20 years on with that person.

title: Views on the sexes (his opinions)
statement: Understand women through both biology and culture; women's emotional intelligence is a strength; rights come with duties; a trad wife is "built, not born" and men must embody those values first; men should be held to higher standards. He also made strongly gendered, contested predictions (his view only).
numbers: 2022 prediction: a wave of suicides among childless women in their 30s-40s within 10-15 years (his unverified claim).

title: Porn, not masturbation, is the problem
statement: Porn is more addictive than steroids or stimulants, escalates, and destroys respect for women and the capacity for relationships; quitting it is "one of the most important self-improvement issues today". NoPorn is realistic where NoFap isn't. Quit with a pact, parental controls held by someone you trust, and thinking of the consequences.

title: Controlled masturbation; NoFap is a meme
statement: Masturbation is acceptable if controlled, imagination only and never sexual media. NoFap/semen retention began as a 4chan meme, is potentially dangerous, breeds resentment of women, and is useful only to break a porn addiction. Jelqing is pointless.
numbers: About twice a week to every two days at most.

title: Straight edge; no controlled use
statement: He takes no drugs, alcohol or painkillers (refused them with broken ribs), except an occasional glass of red wine. "There is no controlled use": if you need it, the drug is in charge. Alcohol is the most dangerous drug because it is normalised. On policy, give real reasons rather than empty stigma or a coercive war on drugs.

title: Video games: the unrecognised addiction
statement: Video games are the number one addiction of young men with addictive personalities, copying real achievement's rewards without consequences. The more time a game demands, the worse; prefer finite, pausable games. MOBAs are the worst.
numbers: Offline RPG sessions ~2 h.

title: Social media is poison for the young
statement: Social media is "to women what porn is to men", and outrage-bait warps young men's view of women. Count hours on Instagram or porn as pure loss; TV with family can be legitimate recovery.

title: Few friends, for life
statement: Be extremely selective with friends, but friendship is for life. True friends tell hard truths and show up; friendship rests on shared virtue, not interest.
numbers: He can count his friends on two hands.

title: Curate your circle
statement: Seek asymmetric friendships (people above who help you, people below whom you help). Cut off narcissists, even family, and whoever holds you back. You can't save people who don't want saving; bad company is worse than solitude.

title: Loneliness is your responsibility
statement: Start conversations at cafés, libraries and the gym, create your own third spaces now that churches are gone, and don't isolate when you feel bad. Strong affectionate bonds between men are normal.

title: Order your concern in circles
statement: Yourself first, then family, community, country and the world last. People who claim to care about everyone are usually virtue signalling. Help when you can but preserve yourself.

title: Children need love, challenge and boundaries
statement: Children need structure, routine and firm boundaries; modern parenting makes the child royalty. Fathers should let boys take risks and roughhouse. The greatest gift is teaching the power of hard work. Raise children in a moral framework and let them choose a religion later.
numbers: His plans: no screens until ~7-8; homeschooling until ~6-7, then possibly half days.

title: Your 20s set your trajectory
statement: Use youth's spare time to discover who you are, enjoy your 20s without damaging your future, and master your emotions early. Finding what you want from lifting in your 20s is not too late; living with parents to save money while contributing is "not unmanly".

title: No submission owed to abusive parents
statement: You owe no submission to a bad or abusive parent; children should bide their time and leave rather than turn to violence. Honouring ancestors also means honouring the life you were given; blaming your genetics insults those who struggled so you could exist.

title: Incels are made, not born
statement: Inceldom is arrested development from mistreatment and missing rites of passage, so it can be reversed. Stop forum and black-pill channels, get a dog, and reintegrate. Bashing or banning incels reinforces the mentality; their real drive is acceptance and status, and the root is resentment where there should be gratitude.

title: Modern humans are devolving
statement: Humans are devolving physically, intellectually and morally by trying to exit nature and abolish suffering. Culture follows its myths: when its heroes turn mediocre, so do its people. Nostalgia is futile.

title: Politically independent
statement: He refuses any party's package, holding views from several camps, and puts freedom above security. He critiques democracy as rewarding the average. Lifters lean right through in-group values, and the left should drop its hostility to physical culture.

title: Social and political claims he made
statement: His own unverified opinions: against COVID vaccine mandates; the toilet-paper shortage was manufactured; Islam may become France's largest religion within ~20 years; a "fit dictatorship" would be dangerous; insect protein is economical but not sustainable, and food waste should be tackled first.
numbers: ~1/3 of food wasted (his figure); ~20-year religion prediction.

title: His claims about real people
statement: All his unverified opinions: he calls Zyzz an insecure drug addict and "the opposite of a role model"; says Liver King's tenets weren't dumb but the marketing was; says island-retreat gurus follow a cult pattern; argued a critic (Blaha) is closeted, conceding it is only a theory; and read Tate's chess anecdote as possible sadism.

title: Anime and manga started his lifting
section: Anime and manga as his origin
statement: Anime and manga (Baki, Berserk, Hunter x Hunter, Yu Yu Hakusho, shonen training arcs) are the source of his lifting motivation and the reason the channel exists; his big-arm obsession comes from anime heroes.

title: His first training came from manga
section: Anime and manga as his origin
statement: His first training was manga-style push-ups and sit-ups, starting from zero push-ups; shonen training arcs remain his favourite part of manga. Watching Dragon Ball or Baki growing up drives many of the biggest naturals.
numbers: Started from 0 push-ups.

title: Fictional role models are valid
section: Anime and manga as his origin
statement: Motivation comes from realism (real athletes) or fiction (manga, myth); he draws mainly from fiction, and without real role models fictional ones are valid. Model yourself on a male character you admire rather than an anime "waifu".

title: Fictional physiques are fine fuel
statement: Fictional physiques are valid goals and motivation if you sort out what is natty-achievable; constant exposure to great physiques reminds you to strive. Fans copy heroes' physiques rather than their feats because the feats are impossible.

title: His goal physique over time
statement: His goal moved from adult Gon to a Zodd/Guts/Uvogin/Toguro mix (Guts has too much shoulder for his taste) to an explicitly unreachable anime body, which is why he keeps striving. Real-world favourites: Serge Nubret's physique and Sergio Oliva's arms.
numbers: 2020: adult Gon; 2022: Zodd/Guts/Uvogin/Toguro; 2023: HxH-style unreachable body.
status: contradicted — in 2020 he also said he "never looked up to any physique" and was his own standard, the same year he named adult Gon as his goal. The later shifts are refinements.

title: Realistic vs unrealistic fictional targets
statement: Golden Age Guts and Toji (Jujutsu Kaisen) are realistic; other Guts arcs are too unrealistic or imbalanced; Yujiro is unachievable even with drugs. Many Baki physiques would need full bodybuilding specialisation, and being that big while staying nimble is impossible.
numbers: Guts built his body over ~7 years; "not even 50 years of training" gives Hanayama's body.

title: Shonen is about self-improvement
statement: The real goal of shonen is self-improvement; strength and physique are means. Physique and feats together inspire because form and function complete each other.

title: Copying anime training doesn't work
statement: Anime regimens are deliberately exaggerated; swinging a sword like Guts won't build his body, resistance training will. Fiction tropes are not methods: weighted clothing, cliff-jumping for reaction time, or the Solo Leveling daily quest (Saitama's joke routine followed unironically).
numbers: Solo Leveling quest: 100 push-ups/sit-ups/squats + 10 km; Baki's 2 kg shoe soles.
check: Is the plan built on resistance training rather than a copied fictional routine?

title: His character programs
statement: He offers a free Guts-physique program for those who only care about the look and planned a Casca program for women who want to be jacked. Halberd swings mimic a lat pulldown and standing Russian twists.

title: Power fantasies are a healthy heritage
statement: Male power fantasies show men who they wish to be. They have always existed (Greek and Norse myth, chansons de geste, Mahabharata, manga), give men a blueprint and keep masculine standards alive; shonen is today's most effective vehicle. Bodybuilding's admiration of the male body is a power fantasy, not lust.

title: Earned power vs handed-out power
statement: Healthy fantasies show earned growth (Luffy's training, Goku and Vegeta, Ippo). Bloodline and destiny weaken the message. Solo Leveling and isekai are toxic: random power means the hero isn't responsible for his growth, and it "works like porn". Values stick when shown through a hero's journey.
numbers: He predicts Solo Leveling forgotten in ~5 years, Berserk lasting 100.
check: Does the role model earn his strength through work rather than receive it by chance?

title: Modern shonen heroes went soft
statement: Modern shonen heroes are "crybabies" (male weakness fantasies) compared with hypermasculine 80s-90s heroes. Dragon Ball Super got worse because power-ups stopped showing as bigger bodies. In male power fantasies violence is never normalised; it fights violence or prepares for it.

title: In Baki, training beats talent
statement: Baki overtook the gifted Hanayama and Rihito's untrained grip stagnated; Baki trains in a large share of panels, which he reads as storytelling that training is the right way. Characters train regardless of bad days or weather.
numbers: Baki trains in 25-30% of his panels; Hanayama grew for 4 years without training once.

title: Jack Hanma is the PED cautionary tale
statement: Jack is the only PED user in Baki and embodies the PED mindset and advanced bigorexia: living for the present and sacrificing his future. He never matches his natural father, so he's no role model; the rest are officially natural.
numbers: Jack's stack: testosterone, Deca, Anavar, Tren.

title: Size vs skill in fighting fiction
statement: Size and power remove the need for technique against average fighters and some muscle is necessary, but skilled, faster fighters beat giants, which is why weight classes exist. Baki's gains went to the upper back and posterior chain, which transfer ground force into strikes.

title: Other lessons he reads into Baki
statement: Baki shows men in their 50s still jacked; downsizing arcs show a leaner base with no strength loss; it covers body dysmorphia, depression and meaning and is grounded in realism. Its physiques escalate each arc like pro bodybuilding and lose charm in *Son of Ogre*.
numbers: Baki downsized 180 → 160 lb.

title: Guts is a tragic hero, not a template
statement: Guts is a tragic hero, not an anti-hero. Young men copy his pathological traits (lone wolf, violence, the memefied stoic chad) instead of the virtues he tries to preserve. Young Guts used sword training and exhaustion to escape existential pain.
status: changed — 2021: Golden Age Guts as a physique target; 2023: warns against copying his psychology (the physique stays fine; Guts program offered 2024).

title: Berserk's lesson is about relationships
statement: Relationships anchor our humanity, so self-improvement should aim at becoming more loving. Berserk is a love story and, in his reading, a feminist work; its fans are emotionally sensitive, not gore addicts.

title: Be an active pessimist and master your fate
statement: He calls himself an active pessimist like Guts, prepared for failure, while active optimists like Griffith collapse when they fail. Learned helplessness (Corkus blaming talent) is the flaw to avoid. Revenge never heals.

title: Yujiro is the shadow of masculinity
statement: Yujiro is toxic hypermasculinity coded as what not to be; Baki is his opposite. The hyper-male (chaos, instinct) differs from the alpha (order, hierarchy). In his view the father brings challenge and the mother comfort.

title: "Literally me" villains
statement: Young men idolise villains like Patrick Bateman as catharsis for restricted masculinity. Bateman is surface-level (looks, muscle, money) and stands for men measuring worth by possessions.

title: France's swole-shaming culture
statement: France has a swole-shaming problem: "gonflette" exists only to mock lifters, Paris men lose muscle yearly, and he was once one of those "wimps". He calls France the "wimpiest country"; Hollywood's 80s jock-villain taught that big means bad. He links America's admiration of big men to a Protestant ethic.

title: Bodies reflect minds in fiction
statement: *300* is fair "masculine propaganda" that pushes men to act, the phalanx mirroring a high-trust society of strong individuals. In *Dune* the lean Atreides vs the obese Baron shows bodies reflecting minds. Mishima went from cerebral boy to man of physical culture through a deliberate plan.

title: Physical-competition TV
statement: A Korean physical-competition show models camaraderie and counters body positivity, but equating torso sculptures with capability is a trap. Strength-heavy tests skew against women; season 2 fixed the stamina emphasis.

title: Vikings as the modern power archetype
statement: Viking imagery dominates lifting culture as the modern archetype of power; Vikings needed exceptional strength for axe fighting and groomed well.
numbers: Weekly baths.

title: Indian physical culture
statement: Vedic archery and riding; epic-age javelin, club swinging and wrestling; a decline under Buddhist influence and British rule; revival in the 1920s.
numbers: Legendary 1000 gada swings each morning.

title: Medieval people trained hard
statement: The average medieval man had a dedicated gym rat's development; exercise was social and outdoors. Knights trained from about age 10 as squires (armour carries, stone throws, weighted ladder pull-ups, presses).
numbers: Knighted at 21 after 10+ years; ~35% died before 20 but many adults reached their 60s-80s.

title: Sandow and the old strongmen
statement: Sandow founded an Institute of Physical Culture with judged shows, sold mail-order plans (the first personal trainer) and was filmed by Edison. He recommends Desbonnet's book on old strongmen as proof of natural excellence. Steve Reeves credited breathing squats for ribcage expansion; worth testing.
numbers: Institute 1897; mail-order plans $10; professor to George V 1911; died at 58.

title: Gymnastics is "anti-powerlifting"
statement: Gymnastics holds the hardest positions for aesthetic criteria; it began in Greece and was revived by German educators. Eastern European calisthenics strength reflects the parks available there.
numbers: Russia has 5,000+ calisthenics parks.

title: Let people work in
statement: A gym is a community, not your property: let people work in on machines and stations; refusing on barbell lifts is understandable. When spotting, be patient and don't grab the bar early; you can decline to spot.

title: Don't interrupt people mid-set
statement: Don't talk to people mid-set or step into their sightline; headphones mean no chat. Don't give women unsolicited advice mid-set or watch them in the mirror. Never step over someone's barbell.

title: Big regulars are supportive
statement: In years of training he has never had a problem with a woman at the gym; offenders are almost always men. Women in male-dominated gyms are often defensive from discomfort. The biggest regulars are the most supportive, so novices needn't fear them. French gym-goers are ruder than Americans.

title: Women's training is not a men's program in pink
statement: Women should train more lower body than men and don't need the bench press (flyes can do the job). A real women's program was planned, "not a men's program painted pink". Female-only gyms rarely work because men pay most memberships.
numbers: ~2% of viewers are women (99% men in 2020).

title: How he reviews programs
statement: Read the lifter's goals and limitations first, then review the program "cold" because it must stand on its own. Paid physique reviews need many photos and videos. He only shares methods he has used and seen work. Write sets and reps with consistent notation.

title: Measure with a tight tape
statement: Measure with the tape pulled tight and no slack, at the thickest part (thigh) or flexed (arm); a loose tape is cheating.

title: Read manga rather than watch anime
statement: He prefers reading manga and usually watches only anime he has already read; Yu Yu Hakusho is the exception where the anime is better. Mocking anime fans reflects conformism; dismissing all anime is like dismissing all cinema.
numbers: Thousands of manga read since age 10; ~1000 physical volumes.

title: His favourite works
statement: One Piece is the greatest manga of all time (Hunter x Hunter could have rivalled it). Eyeshield 21 is a top-3 sports manga with a science-based vs Spartan training arc; Shin is his favourite character, and like Guts, Zoro and Shin he prefers training alone. Dune is his favourite book (2024).
status: contradicted — favourite film: Star Wars Episode III (2021) vs Watchmen (2022); favourite fiction: a French YA fantasy series (2022) vs Dune (2024).

title: Books he rereads
statement: He has reread the *Book of Five Rings* every summer since 22 (it must be read between the lines) and ranks the Hagakure books 2 > 1 > 3.
numbers: Yearly since age 22.

title: Miyazaki and film opinions
statement: *The Boy and the Heron* is one of Miyazaki's worst films (rushed, nostalgia recycling) yet better than 99% of Japanese animation; he rewatches *Mononoke* and *Spirited Away* yearly.
numbers: Five themes in ~2 hours.

title: Grip and Eastern methods appeal to him
statement: Grip strength is the expression of strength that draws him most, and a common manga power fantasy. He prefers Eastern training methods to Western ones.

title: The channel is public domain
statement: All channel content is public domain: no strikes, anyone may re-upload, and the best help is archiving. He would not recreate the channel if deleted. In 2022 Japanese companies struck his anime videos for months and YouTube auto-rejected his counter-claims; he considers his anime videos transformative fair use.
numbers: ~15 Baki videos struck, restored after ~5 months.

title: Channel formats
statement: Q&As are monthly (hypertrophy), injury every ~2 months and nutrition every ~3. Long videos are split. The philosophy series (Educated Barbarian) became rarer and longer, later moving to Jung streams and weekly Wednesday streams; background music was dropped by vote.
numbers: Videos over ~20 min split; streams weekly (2024-2025).
